## 5. How to Run the Application & Download Live Traffic

### 5.1 Start Backend API
```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn backend.server:app --port 8000 --reload
```
API docs available at: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs`

### 5.2 Start Frontend Dashboard
```powershell
cd sentinel-ids-source
npm run dev
```
Open `http://localhost:8080` in browser.

### 5.3 Live Traffic Capture & CSV Download Options
1. **Via Web Dashboard:**
   - Navigate to **Live Traffic** (`/traffic`).
   - Click **Start Live Capture** to begin real-time packet sniffing and flow classification.
   - Click **Download Captured CSV** at any time to export live analyzed flows.
2. **Via Command Line Utility:**
   ```powershell
   .\.venv\Scripts\python tools/download_live_traffic.py --duration 10 --out live_flows.csv
   ```
3. **Via Direct REST API:**
   ```powershell
   Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/capture/download" -OutFile "live_traffic.csv"
   ```
